Add the noodles, soft tofu, rice cakes, and shrimp. Cover and cook for about 2 minutes. 6. Return the octopus and add the bok choy. Cook just until the shrimp turn pink and the bok choy is tender-crisp. 7. Top with the crispy egg, an extra egg yolk (optional), and fresh red chili.
